snippet.title: Cup Or Die - Trailer [Wishlist On Steam]
snippet.description:
Cup or Die - a deadly mix of beer pong, psychological horror, and rogue-lite, where a simple game turns into a survival ritual.
Use various items to turn the tide of the game.

Each glass has its own consequences—a buff, a curse, or even instant death.
Find your perfect build of items and cards with passive effects to escape the sinister bar alive.
The project is inspired by games like Buckshot Roulette, Inscryption, and Clover Pit
